title: Behavior-Induced Mirror-Prox Temporal-Difference Learning for Faster Off-Policy Prediction
summary: Gradient temporal-difference methods provide stable off-policy prediction with linear function approximation, but their practical performance is strongly affected by the geometry induced by the auxiliary-variable metric. Existing Mirror-Prox TD methods typically use the feature covariance metric, whereas hybrid TD methods suggest that behavior-policy transition information can provide a more informative update geometry. This paper proposes a behavior-induced Mirror-Prox temporal-difference method, called STHTD-MP, which replaces the covariance metric in the primal-dual saddle-point formulation with the symmetric part of the behavior-policy Bellman matrix. The method keeps a single learning rate for the primal and auxiliary variables and applies a Mirror-Prox prediction-correction step to the resulting hybrid saddle-point operator. We provide a formal convergence analysis for fixed-policy linear prediction under standard stochastic approximation assumptions: the behavior-induced metric is positive definite, the joint mean system is Hurwitz, boundedness follows from a Lyapunov argument, and the stochastic recursion converges by the ODE method. We further derive projected-oracle ergodic gap bounds and an exact mean-operator comparison with GTD2-MP based on the spectral radius of the deterministic Mirror-Prox error matrix. The analysis shows that STHTD-MP can have a smaller mean contraction factor than GTD2-MP when the behavior-induced metric improves the saddle-point geometry. Exact numerical mean-operator analysis on two-state, Random Walk, and Boyan Chain benchmarks supports this condition, while Baird's counterexample is identified as a singular boundary case where the strict assumptions fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STHTD-MP方法，用行为策略Bellman矩阵的对称部分替代协方差度量作为Mirror-Prox TD的几何结构，证明其在特定条件下比GTD2-MP具有更小的均值收缩因子，并给出了完整的收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度时序差分(GTD)方法的实际性能受辅助变量度量几何的强烈影响。Mirror-Prox TD方法通常使用特征协方差度量，而混合TD方法表明行为策略的转移信息能提供更具信息量的更新几何。本文旨在结合两者优势，提出行为诱导的Mirror-Prox时序差分方法。
AI.method: 1) 在对偶-原始鞍点公式中，用行为策略Bellman矩阵的对称部分替换协方差度量；2) 对主变量和辅助变量使用单一学习率；3) 对所得混合鞍点算子应用Mirror-Prox预测-校正步骤；4) 通过ODE方法进行随机递归收敛分析；5) 基于确定性Mirror-Prox误差矩阵的谱半径推导投影oracle遍历间隙界和均值算子比较。
AI.result: 1) 证明了行为诱导度量正定、联合均值系统Hurwitz、有界性由Lyapunov论证保证、随机递归通过ODE方法收敛；2) 推导了投影oracle遍历间隙界；3) 给出了与GTD2-MP的精确均值算子比较，证明STHTD-MP在行为诱导度量改善鞍点几何时具有更小的均值收缩因子；4) 在Two-state、Random Walk和Boyan Chain基准上验证了理论分析；5) 识别Baird反例为奇异边界情况，其中严格假设不成立。
AI.conclusion: STHTD-MP通过引入行为策略转移信息改进了Mirror-Prox TD方法的几何结构，在理论收敛性和实际性能上均优于基于协方差度量的GTD2-MP方法，为非策略预测任务提供了更稳定的更新几何。

title: Behavior-Aware Auxiliary Corrections for Off-Policy Temporal-Difference Prediction
summary: Temporal-difference learning with function approximation can be unstable under off-policy sampling. TDC stabilizes off-policy TD through an auxiliary covariance correction, and TDRC further regularizes this correction in a single-timescale recursion. This paper studies a behavior-aware replacement of the auxiliary covariance geometry in the linear prediction setting, which is the standard local model for understanding the feature-space dynamics of value-function approximation. We first replace the TDC auxiliary matrix (C) by the behavior Bellman matrix (A_μ), yielding BA-TDC, and then regularize the same behavior-aware equation to obtain BA-TDRC. This two-step construction separates the contribution of behavior-aware geometry from the contribution of regularization. The linear analysis also provides a tractable model for an auxiliary-geometry design question that arises in neural-network value approximation, where feature covariances and temporal transition matrices jointly shape the last-layer correction dynamics. We give a finite-state mean-system formulation, prove fixed-point preservation and almost-sure convergence under a Hurwitz stability condition on the instantiated mean system, and compare deterministic mean rates through the spectral radius of the exact linear error recursion. Experiments on the two-state counterexample, Baird's counterexample, Random Walk, and Boyan Chain show that the behavior-aware replacement can be highly beneficial by itself on some tasks, but that regularization is necessary for robust performance across harder settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在离线策略线性预测中，用行为贝尔曼矩阵替换TDC/TDRC的辅助协方差矩阵，提出BA-TDC和BA-TDRC方法，理论分析其固定点保持、几乎必然收敛性，并通过实验验证行为感知几何与正则化的不同贡献。
AI.motivation: TDC通过辅助协方差校正稳定了离线策略TD学习，TDRC进一步引入了单时间尺度的正则化。但辅助协方差矩阵的设计是否最优尚不明确，本文旨在探索行为感知的替代几何结构，并分离几何设计与正则化各自的贡献。
AI.method: 首先将TDC的辅助矩阵C替换为行为贝尔曼矩阵A_μ，得到BA-TDC；然后对该行为感知方程进行正则化，得到BA-TDRC。通过线性预测设定下的均方系统分析、固定点分析、几乎必然收敛性证明以及谱半径比较，系统研究行为感知几何的影响。
AI.result: BA-TDC和BA-TDRC保持了固定点不变和几乎必然收敛性（在Hurwitz稳定性条件下）。实验表明行为感知替换本身在某些任务上效果显著，但对于更难的设置，正则化是鲁棒性能的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 行为感知的几何设计可以提升离线策略TD学习的性能，但单独使用并不足够鲁棒，需要结合正则化才能应对更复杂的环境。
idea_en: A method for stabilizing off-policy temporal-difference learning by replacing the auxiliary covariance matrix (C) in TDC with a behavior Bellman matrix (A_μ), resulting in a behavior-aware geometry that improves learning dynamics.

A regularized behavior-aware temporal-difference learning method (BA-TDRC) that combines behavior Bellman matrix replacement with regularization, enabling robust performance across diverse off-policy tasks.
A finite-state mean-system formulation for analyzing the linear error dynamics of behavior-aware TD learning, providing a tractable model to study convergence and spectral properties.
A Hurwitz stability condition-based convergence analysis framework that guarantees almost-sure convergence for behavior-aware off-policy TD learning algorithms.
A spectral radius comparison method for deterministic mean rates that allows quantitative evaluation of different auxiliary geometry designs in linear TD learning.

title: The Cognitive Categorical Transformer: Category-Theoretic Inductive Biases for Language Modeling
summary: The Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT) is a 306M-parameter architecture that augments a pretrained GPT-2 Small backbone with cognitively grounded components derived from category theory and several inspirations from cognitive science. Under a matched-step protocol (215,000 optimizer steps, matched data, matched optimizer and schedule) on WikiText-103, CCT reaches 21.27 validation perplexity, compared with 24.19 for an identically fine-tuned GPT-2 Small baseline. The architecture therefore contributes a 2.92 PPL (12% relative) reduction beyond what in-domain fine-tuning alone provides. A retrain-from-scratch ablation that holds GT-Full simplicial message passing bypassed across the entire seven-phase activation schedule reaches 23.72 PPL, localizing 84% of the architectural improvement (2.45 of 2.92 PPL) to GT-Full. We present the first ablation-validated evidence that simplicial message passing improves language-model perplexity at the 306M-parameter scale on WikiText-103. Published GPT-2 Large reaches 22.05 zero-shot PPL on WikiText-103 with 6.2x more parameters than GPT-2 Small; this paper treats that number as an external published reference, not as the architectural benchmark. Three negative results on consistency-style categorical priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) and the joint structural-prior result for GT-Full and PrecisionWeightedPP together support an empirical pattern termed the *structure/consistency distinction*, in which categorical priors that add new topology improve language modeling and those that enforce a consistency identity do not.

AI.tldr: Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT) 通过在GPT-2 Small骨干网络上增加认知启发的范畴论组件（特别是单纯复形消息传递GT-Full），在WikiText-103上将验证困惑度从24.19降至21.27（降低2.92 PPL，12%相对提升），并通过消融实验证实84%的改进归因于GT-Full，同时提出了结构/一致性区分模式。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以将范畴论和认知科学启发的结构（如单纯复形消息传递）集成到预训练语言模型中，以超越传统微调的性能提升。
AI.method: 在预训练的GPT-2 Small骨干上增加基于范畴论的认知组件（GT-Full单纯复形消息传递），在匹配的优化步骤、数据和调度条件下，在WikiText-103上微调，并进行从零重新训练的消融实验。
AI.result: CCT达到21.27验证困惑度，比GPT-2 Small基线（24.19）低2.92（12%相对提升）；消融实验证明84%的改进来自GT-Full；GPT-2 Large（6.2x参数）零样本困惑度为22.05。
AI.conclusion: 首次通过消融实验验证了单纯复形消息传递在306M参数规模上能提升语言模型困惑度；提出了结构/一致性区分模式——增加新拓扑结构的范畴先验有效，强制一致性恒等式的先验无效。
idea_en: Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT) architecture augmenting pretrained GPT-2 Small with category-theory-based simplicial message passing (GT-Full) for improved language modeling perplexity.
Simplicial message passing mechanism (GT-Full) that adds new topological structure to transformer hidden states, validated via ablation to reduce perplexity by 2.45 PPL at 306M-parameter scale.

title: Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL): propose a new method for selective sustainable logging and post-harvest silvicultural treatment in tropical forest using airborne robotics systems
comment: 196 pages, 40 figures, A revolutionary technology to help protect tropical forests. It was developed, scaled, detailed, calculated, and simulated in an advanced computational environment, com viabilidade econômica e social. "E pur si muove"
summary: Tropical forests worldwide are under intense deforestation pressure driven by economic and political interests, and scientific evidence suggests this deforestation contributes to climate change. This paper proposes a novel logging method for tropical forests, Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL). This new method is based on heli-logging techniques combined with intensive use of robotics and AI integrated with post-harvest silvicultural treatments performed by drones. The concept of appropriate equipment for this method was developed, dimensions were determined, details were completed in a digital proof of concept, and an effective digital simulation and economic feasibility analysis were carried out for various helicopter-timber-distance combinations. The results demonstrated that a URIEL method has high economic viability and makes it possible to virtually eliminate collateral damage to forests while maintaining ecosystem services. The main conclusion of this paper is that, despite the satisfactory scientific and technological results, the feasibility of a Uriel method depends on the integration of stakeholders intrinsic to the context: high-tech industry; political governments; certified logging companies; and native populations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型热带森林采伐方法URIEL（超减影响封装式伐木），结合直升机组伐、机器人和AI技术，以及无人机执行的采后造林处理，能够在维持经济可行性的同时几乎消除对森林的附带损害。
AI.motivation: 热带森林面临严重的采伐压力，导致气候变化，需要一种既能满足经济需求又能最大限度减少生态破坏的新型采伐方法。
AI.method: 基于直升机组伐（heli-logging）技术，结合机器人和AI的密集使用，以及由无人机执行的采后造林处理。进行了数字概念验证、模拟和经济可行性分析。
AI.result: URIEL方法具有高经济可行性，几乎完全消除了对森林的附带损害，同时维持了生态系统服务。
AI.conclusion: 尽管技术成果令人满意，但URIEL方法的可行性取决于多方利益相关者的整合：高科技产业、政治政府、认证伐木公司和原住民群体。

title: Review Arcade: On the Human Alignment and Gameability of LLM Reviews
comment: Under Review EMNLP 26
summary: LLM-generated reviews for scientific papers are gaining considerable traction and are even being officially piloted by major conferences. We have to assume that not only reviewers are using LLM-assistance, but also that authors use LLMs to revise their papers before submitting. In this work, we perform empirical experiments on papers from the 2025 ACL Rolling Review (ARR) to evaluate LLM reviews from both the author and the reviewer perspective. First, we identify a limited alignment of LLM reviews with human ones. In the best-case scenario, the alignment is reasonable. However, we also find that LLM-human alignment varies substantially across prompts and models. Finally, we investigate the scenario in which the author uses an iterative draft-revise workflow to improve the submission according to the LLM review. We find that this "gaming" of LLM reviews can be effective in specific scenarios, leading to a statistically significant increase of overall scores for up to 35\% of papers. We publish our code: https://github.com/uhh-hcds/reviewarcade.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验分析了LLM在学术论文评审中的应用，发现LLM评审与人类评审一致性有限，且存在作者利用LLM评审迭代修改论文以"刷分"的风险，最高可使35%的论文获得统计显著的总分提升。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生成的论文评审被大型会议官方试点使用，需要评估LLM评审的质量及其被滥用的风险，特别是从作者和评审者双视角进行实证研究。
AI.method: 基于2025年ACL Rolling Review (ARR)的论文数据，从评审者和作者两个角度进行实验：1) 比较LLM生成评审与人类评审的一致性；2) 测试不同提示词和模型对一致性的影响；3) 模拟作者根据LLM评审迭代修改论文的"游戏"场景，评估分数提升效果。
AI.result: LLM评审与人类评审对齐有限，最佳场景下也仅为合理水平；不同提示词和模型下一致性差异显著；在特定场景下，作者通过迭代修改可有效"刷分"，最高35%的论文获得统计显著的总分提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审存在被作者利用进行针对性修改以提升评分的安全风险，会议评审系统需要防范此类"游戏"行为。
idea_en: A method for detecting LLM-gaming in peer review by analyzing revision patterns between submission versions and comparing them against known LLM review response profiles

An anti-gaming peer review system that uses multiple diverse prompt templates and LLM models to generate review scores, then cross-validates to identify inconsistent score improvements indicative of targeted revision

A system for evaluating LLM-human review alignment that quantifies variance across prompts and models, providing a robustness score for automated review processes

title: Orthogonal Concept Erasure for Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Oral
summary: Concept erasure has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate undesired or unsafe content in diffusion models, yet existing methods still face significant limitations. While training-based methods are effective, their high computational cost limits scalability. Editing-based methods are more efficient and deployment-friendly, yet they struggle to simultaneously achieve precise concept erasure and preserve overall generative capacity. We identify this core limitation of the editing-based methods as reliance on additive parameter updates. Our empirical analysis reveals that concept semantics primarily depend on neuron direction rather than neuron magnitude, while overall generative capacity relies on the angular geometry of neurons. As additive updates inherently entangle direction, magnitude, and angular geometry, they inevitably introduce unintended interference between concept erasure and overall generation performance. To address this, we propose Orthogonal Concept Erasure (OCE), which reformulates editing-based erasure as multiplicative parameter updates from a geometric perspective. Specifically, OCE applies layer-wise orthogonal transformations derived from a closed-form solution to the parameters, enabling precise concept erasure while preserving the neuron magnitude and angular geometry. Furthermore, to address conflicting constraints in multi-concept erasure, OCE introduces a subspace-level objective with structured subspace manipulation, yielding a more effective and scalable erasure. Extensive experiments on single- and multi-concept erasure demonstrate that OCE outperforms existing methods in concept erasure and non-target preservation, erasing up to 100 concepts in 4.3 s. Code: https://github.com/HansSunY/OCE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出正交概念擦除（OCE）方法，通过乘法参数更新（而非加法更新）从几何角度解决扩散模型中的概念擦除问题，实现精确擦除同时保持生成能力，支持单/多概念擦除，速度达4.3秒擦除100个概念。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法中，基于训练的方法计算成本高，基于编辑的方法虽高效但难以同时实现精确概念擦除和保持整体生成能力。论文发现根本原因在于编辑方法依赖加法参数更新，会纠缠神经元方向、幅度和角度几何，导致概念擦除与生成性能之间的意外干扰。
AI.method: 提出正交概念擦除(OCE)：1) 将编辑式擦除重构为乘法参数更新，从闭式解推导逐层正交变换，实现精确概念擦除同时保持神经元幅度和角度几何；2) 针对多概念擦除的冲突约束，引入子空间级目标函数与结构化子空间操作，实现更有效且可扩展的擦除。
AI.result: 在单概念和多概念擦除任务上，OCE在概念擦除效果和非目标保持方面均优于现有方法，可在4.3秒内擦除多达100个概念。
AI.conclusion: OCE通过几何视角的正交乘法更新，有效解决了编辑式概念擦除中精确性与生成能力保持之间的权衡问题，为扩散模型的安全控制提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案。
idea_en: Orthogonal Concept Erasure (OCE): A method reformulating editing-based concept erasure as multiplicative parameter updates using orthogonal transformations derived from closed-form solutions, enabling precise concept erasure while preserving neuron magnitude and angular geometry.

Subspace-level objective with structured subspace manipulation for multi-concept erasure: A technique that addresses conflicting constraints in multi-concept erasure through structured subspace manipulations, improving scalability and effectiveness.

Layer-wise orthogonal transformation mechanism: Applying orthogonal transformations to each layer of diffusion models to achieve concept erasure without additive parameter updates, avoiding unintended interference with overall generative capacity.

Closed-form solution for orthogonal concept erasure parameters: Deriving orthogonal transformation parameters from closed-form mathematical solutions rather than iterative optimization, enabling fast (4.3s for 100 concepts) and scalable concept erasure.

Geometry-preserving concept erasure: A method that maintains neuron magnitude and angular geometry of the model during concept erasure, preserving overall generative capacity while removing undesired concepts.
idea_ch: 正交概念擦除(OCE)：将编辑式概念擦除重构为乘法参数更新的方法，利用闭式解推导的正交变换，在精确擦除概念的同时保持神经元的幅度和角度几何结构。
子空间级多概念擦除技术：通过结构化子空间操作解决多概念擦除中的冲突约束问题，提高多概念擦除的可扩展性和有效性。
逐层正交变换机制：对扩散模型的每一层应用正交变换实现概念擦除，避免加法参数更新对整体生成能力的意外干扰。
闭式解正交擦除参数推导：从数学闭式解而非迭代优化中推导正交变换参数，实现快速（100个概念仅需4.3秒）且可扩展的概念擦除。
几何保持型概念擦除方法：在概念擦除过程中维持神经元的幅度和角度几何，在移除不期望概念的同时保持整体生成能力。

title: Frontier LLM-based agents can overcome the ontology curation bottleneck for natural phenotypes
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: Linking free-text phenotype descriptions to ontology terms, typically referred to as phenotype annotation, is essential for the cross-study integration of comparative morphological data. This labor intensive process has heavily relied on highly trained human experts, which makes it challenging to scale and thus a key bottleneck. Dahdul et al. (2018) established a Gold Standard (GS) of Entity-Quality (EQ) annotations across seven phylogenetic studies and used it to evaluate three human curators and the Semantic CharaParser NLP tool with ontology-based semantic similarity metrics; they reported that machine-human consistency was significantly lower than inter-curator (human-human) consistency. Here we revisit that benchmark with five frontier hosted LLMs from Anthropic and OpenAI, each operating as an "agentic curator" within a self-contained workspace that supplies the source publication PDF, the same annotation guide used by the original human curators, the four project ontologies (UBERON, PATO, BSPO, GO), and a validation script. Evaluated against the same Gold Standard, every agent fell within the range of inter-curator variability of the three trained human biocurators of the original study; the best performing agents approached but did not reach the best performing human curator. Agents substantially outperformed Semantic CharaParser on all four metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了五个前沿大语言模型（LLMs）作为“智能策展人”进行表型标注的效果，发现其在Gold Standard上的表现完全落入了人类策展人之间的差异范围，虽然未能超越最佳人类策展人，但显著优于传统的NLP工具Semantic CharaParser。
AI.motivation: 解决表型标注（将自由文本表型描述链接到本体术语）这一劳动密集型瓶颈问题，探索LLMs能否替代或接近人类专家的标注能力。
AI.method: 使用五个前沿LLMs（来自Anthropic和OpenAI）作为“智能策展人”，为其提供原始论文PDF、标注指南、四个本体（UBERON, PATO, BSPO, GO）和验证脚本，在Gold Standard上评估其与人类策展人和传统NLP工具的对比表现。
AI.result: 每个智能策展人的表现均落在三位人类策展人之间的差异范围内；最佳代理接近但未超越最佳人类策展人；所有代理在四项指标上均大幅优于Semantic CharaParser。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能策展人能够达到人类水平的表型标注一致性，有望规模化解决表型标注瓶颈，但仍需进一步提升以超越最优人类专家。
idea_en: A method for automated phenotype annotation using large language models as agentic curators, where the LLM is provided with source publication PDF, annotation guidelines, domain ontologies, and a validation script within a self-contained workspace.

A system for Entity-Quality (EQ) annotation that achieves human-level inter-annotator consistency by deploying frontier LLMs with access to multiple structured ontologies (UBERON, PATO, BSPO, GO) and project-specific curation guidelines.

A benchmark framework that evaluates LLM-based phenotype annotation agents against a gold standard of human-curated annotations, demonstrating machine performance within the range of inter-curator variability.
idea_ch: 一种利用大语言模型作为智能策展人进行自动表型标注的方法，在自包含工作空间中为LLM提供源论文PDF、标注指南、领域本体和验证脚本。
一种实现人类级标注者一致性水平的实体-质量（EQ）标注系统，通过部署前沿LLM并接入多个结构化本体（UBERON, PATO, BSPO, GO）及项目特定的策展指南。
一种评估LLM表型标注策展代理的基准测试框架，针对人类策展的金标准进行评价，证明机器表现落在人类策展人间差异范围内。

title: VFEAgent: A Multimodal Agent Framework for End-to-End Automated Finite Element Analysis
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Equal contribution: Jiachen Zhang and Junyi Lao. Corresponding author: Songfang Huang. Preprint
summary: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) serves as the cornerstone of modern engineering design. However, its workflow is inherently complex and relies heavily on domain expertise. Although recent efforts have integrated Large Language Models (LLMs) into FEA, existing approaches face limitations in handling multimodal inputs and executing complex tasks. To address these limitations, we propose VFEAgent, an end-to-end multi-agent system designed to automate FEA modeling and simulation directly from input images and problem descriptions. Our methodology integrates two core components: (1) a multimodal vision-language multi-agent pipeline that employs ReAct-driven reasoning to extract structured FEA specifications from heterogeneous inputs and (2) a verification-first code synthesis framework, incorporating robust self-debugging and fallback mechanisms to ensure executability and physical validity. We systematically evaluated the system across various engineering mechanics scenarios. The results demonstrate that VFEAgent achieves a high success rate in generating complete and physically valid simulations, outperforming LLM-based baseline methods in reliability and correctness. These findings validate the feasibility of automating the complete FEA workflow, highlighting the framework's potential to liberate engineers from tedious manual analysis.

AI.tldr: VFEAgent是一个端到端多智能体系统，可直接从输入图像和问题描述中自动完成有限元分析建模与仿真，解决了现有LLM方法处理多模态输入和执行复杂任务的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统FEA工作流程复杂且高度依赖领域专家经验，现有结合LLM的方法难以处理多模态输入和执行复杂任务，亟需更智能的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出VFEAgent多智能体系统，包含两个核心组件：(1)多模态视觉-语言多智能体管道，采用ReAct驱动推理从异构输入提取结构化FEA规格；(2)验证优先的代码合成框架，集成自我调试和回退机制确保代码可执行性和物理有效性。
AI.result: 在多种工程力学场景下，VFEAgent生成完整且物理有效仿真的成功率很高，在可靠性和正确性上优于基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了自动化完整FEA工作流程的可行性，该框架有潜力将工程师从繁琐的手动分析中解放出来。
idea_en: 1. A multi-agent system architecture that autonomously performs end-to-end FEA modeling and simulation directly from input images and problem descriptions.
2. A multimodal vision-language multi-agent pipeline employing ReAct-driven reasoning to extract structured FEA specifications from heterogeneous inputs (images + text).
3. A verification-first code synthesis framework with self-debugging and fallback mechanisms to ensure executability and physical validity of generated FEA code.
idea_ch: 1. 一种端到端多智能体系统架构，能够直接从输入图像和问题描述中自主完成有限元分析建模与仿真。
2. 一种多模态视觉-语言多智能体管道，采用ReAct驱动推理从异构输入（图像+文本）中提取结构化FEA规格参数。
3. 一种验证优先的代码合成框架，集成自我调试和回退机制，确保生成的FEA代码可执行且物理有效。

title: BEAMS: Benchmarking and Evaluating AI for Modeling and Simulation
summary: AI tools to support real world decision making must be able to build simulation models that inform their recommendations and render them interpretable. Tools that can automate aspects of modeling practice must complement human expertise, not replace it. The BEAMS Initiative aims to guide the development of AI tools for modeling and simulation toward forms that are responsible and ethical by establishing benchmarks for human centered modeling and simulation practices. The initiative uses open digital and organizational infrastructure to collaboratively evaluate AI tools for modeling and simulation. The open source sd ai project hosted by the initiative establishes transparency and enables contributions to be shared broadly. A steering group focuses on prioritizing potential benchmarks, while a technical group focuses on implementing the benchmarks in the form of automated tests. Tests for several distinct categories of evaluation have been implemented and applied to AI tools that support qualitative model building, quantitative model building, and model discussion. These include tests for causal translation, model iteration, causal reasoning, conformance, model behavior explanation, suggested model building steps, and suggested model fixes. When engines from the sd ai project are coupled with different LLMs, their performance on these evaluations reveals variability across different AI tools. The evaluations implemented by the initiative demonstrate that AI enabled modeling tools perform better at discussion and basic qualitative tasks than with causal reasoning and quantitative error fixing. No single LLM dominates across engine types, highlighting the importance of specific tasks and tradeoffs between speed and accuracy. Ongoing efforts of the initiative aim to incorporate benchmarks that address concerns about bias by considering alternative perspectives and human centered use cases.

AI.tldr: BEAMS倡议通过建立开放基准和自动化测试，系统评估AI工具在系统动力学建模与仿真中的表现，发现当前AI工具在因果推理和定量纠错方面较弱，且不同LLM在不同任务上表现各异。
AI.motivation: 现实世界决策需要AI工具能够构建可解释的仿真模型，但现有AI建模工具缺乏标准化评估体系，且需确保AI辅助建模是负责任的、以人为中心的，而非替代人类专家。
AI.method: 建立开放式数字和组织基础设施，设立指导组和技术组；开发开源sd ai项目；定义多个评估类别（因果翻译、模型迭代、因果推理、一致性、模型行为解释、建议建模步骤、建议模型修复）；将评估实现为自动化测试；耦合不同LLM进行性能对比。
AI.result: 评估显示AI工具在讨论和基础定性任务上表现较好，在因果推理和定量误差修复上表现较弱；没有单一LLM在所有引擎类型中占优；不同任务存在速度与准确度之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 需要持续扩展基准以涵盖偏见评估和替代视角；AI建模工具应定位为辅助人类专家而非替代；特定的任务和评估维度对于选择合适AI工具至关重要。
idea_en: A benchmark evaluation system for AI-assisted modeling tools that includes automated test suites covering qualitative model building, quantitative model building, and model discussion capabilities.
A method for systematically evaluating causal reasoning capabilities of AI tools in system dynamics modeling across multiple dimensions including causal translation and causal reasoning.
A model behavior explanation evaluation framework that tests whether AI tools can render their simulation model recommendations interpretable to human users.
A cross-engine evaluation methodology that couples different LLMs with modeling engines and measures performance variability across distinct modeling task categories.
An automated test infrastructure for assessing AI tools' ability to suggest correct model building steps and model fixes for system dynamics simulations.
idea_ch: 一种针对AI辅助建模工具的基准评估系统，包含覆盖定性建模、定量建模和模型讨论能力的自动化测试套件。
一种系统评估AI工具在系统动力学建模中因果推理能力的方法，涵盖因果翻译和因果推理等多个维度。
一种模型行为解释评估框架，测试AI工具是否能将其仿真模型建议以可解释的方式呈现给人类用户。
一种跨引擎评估方法，将不同LLM与建模引擎耦合，并测量在不同建模任务类别上的性能差异。
一种用于评估AI工具提出正确建模步骤和系统动力学仿真模型修复建议能力的自动化测试基础设施。

title: Adopt $\neq$ Adapt: Longitudinal Analyses of LLM Conversations in the Wild
summary: Although a growing body of research has begun to describe user--LLM interactions, the picture it paints is largely static; little is known about how individual users change their behavior over time. To address this gap, we analyze the conversational trajectories of $\sim$12,000 randomly sampled Microsoft Bing Copilot users and compare these with data from WildChat-4.8M. While the Copilot data contains significant population-level trends, we find that trends in individual user trajectories are much weaker; user habits prove to be overwhelmingly sticky. We also find stark differences between users of different activity levels: more active users have more successful conversations and use the LLM for more complex and professionally oriented tasks. Some user trends also appear in WildChat-4.8M, but we find evidence that this dataset is significantly skewed towards highly proficient "power" users. Ultimately, our results suggest that existing user behavior is difficult to change and demonstrate the extent of user heterogeneity. Our comparison between datasets highlights that WildChat does not represent typical user-AI interactions, an important caveat for downstream uses of the data.

AI.tldr: 通过对约12,000名微软Bing Copilot用户的纵向分析，发现用户与LLM的交互行为具有很强的粘性，个体行为变化微弱，且不同活跃度用户存在显著差异；同时指出WildChat数据集严重偏向高熟练度"超级用户"，不能代表典型用户-AI交互。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对用户-LLM交互的描述多为静态分析，缺乏对个体用户行为随时间变化轨迹的纵向研究。
AI.method: 分析约12,000名随机采样的微软Bing Copilot用户的对话轨迹，并与WildChat-4.8M数据集进行对比。
AI.result: 个体用户习惯具有极强的粘性，行为变化微弱；不同活跃度用户差异显著（活跃用户对话更成功、任务更复杂专业）；WildChat数据集严重偏向"超级用户"。
AI.conclusion: 现有用户行为难以改变，用户异质性显著；WildChat不能代表典型用户-AI交互，需谨慎用于下游研究。
idea_en: Method for detecting individual user behavioral stickiness in LLM interactions by analyzing conversational trajectories over time
System for classifying LLM user activity levels and predicting task complexity based on interaction patterns
Method for identifying dataset representation bias in user-AI interaction data by comparing population-level vs individual-level behavioral trends
idea_ch: 一种通过分析对话轨迹随时间变化来检测LLM交互中个体用户行为粘性的方法
一种基于交互模式对LLM用户活跃度进行分类并预测任务复杂度的系统
一种通过比较群体水平与个体水平行为趋势来识别用户-AI交互数据集中代表性偏差的方法

title: When Models Disagree: Rethinking LLM Evaluation for Public Comment Analysis
summary: Federal agencies are deploying large language models (LLMs) to categorize public comment corpora, where the model's organization of the record shapes what policymakers see and which arguments register. Standard evaluation, anchored on stance accuracy against a small validated set, cannot detect when different models produce materially different categorizations of the same public input. We propose an Interpretive Audit Pipeline that treats multi-model disagreement as diagnostic of interpretive complexity and directs human review toward genuinely ambiguous public input. Analyzing 1,260 public comments on a federal USDA docket across four LLMs, we find that inter-model thematic divergence exceeds within-model prompt variation, and that an expert rubric suppresses deep interpretive disagreement without resolving it. In a two-stage labeling study on a stratified 40-comment subsample, four LLMs and a human annotator labeled independently and then revised after seeing the others' labels. Revision behavior varied across labelers, and the human annotator's revisions frequently introduced framings absent from the ensemble's collective output. We argue disagreement-based evaluation is a necessary complement to accuracy metrics for LLM-assisted interpretive coding.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种"解释性审计管道"（Interpretive Audit Pipeline），通过多模型分歧检测来评估LLM对公众意见的分类质量，发现基于准确度的传统评估无法捕捉模型间的实质性分类差异，并建议将分歧作为需要人工审查的指标。
AI.motivation: 当前联邦机构使用LLM对公众意见进行分类，但仅以少数验证集上的立场准确度作为评估标准，无法检测不同模型对同一公众输入产生的实质性分类差异，可能导致政策制定者看到的信息被系统性扭曲。
AI.method: 提出Interpretive Audit Pipeline：(1) 用多个LLM对相同公众意见进行分类，以模型间分歧作为解释复杂性的诊断信号；(2) 将分歧大的样本定向给人工审查；(3) 在40条分层抽取的公众意见上进行两阶段标注实验（独立标注→看他人标注后修订），分析修订行为。
AI.result: 在1,260条USDA公众意见上，模型间的主题分歧超过了同一模型的提示词变异；专家评分标准压制了深层解释分歧但未真正解决它；两阶段标注中，人工标注者的修订经常引入模型集成输出中不存在的框架。
AI.conclusion: 基于分歧的评估是LLM辅助解释性编码中准确度指标的必要补充，不应仅信任单一模型或单一评估标准。
idea_en: Interpretive Audit Pipeline: A multi-model disagreement detection system that automatically identifies ambiguous public comments requiring human review by measuring inter-model divergence in categorization tasks.
Disagreement-driven evaluation framework for LLM-assisted content coding, using model disagreement as a diagnostic signal for interpretive complexity rather than treating it as noise.

Two-stage labeling methodology where human and multiple LLM annotators label independently, then revise after seeing others' labels, capturing revision behavior as a measure of interpretive uncertainty.
Expert rubric suppression detection: method to identify when standardized coding rubrics mask deep interpretive disagreements between models without resolving underlying ambiguity.
Cross-model thematic divergence analysis method that compares inter-model vs. within-model variation to evaluate the robustness of LLM-based public comment categorization.
idea_ch: 解释性审计管道（Interpretive Audit Pipeline）：一种多模型分歧检测系统，通过测量不同模型在分类任务中的分歧程度，自动识别需要人工审查的歧义公众意见。
分歧驱动评估框架：用于LLM辅助内容编码的评估方法，将模型间分歧视为解释复杂性的诊断信号而非噪音，作为准确度指标的必要补充。
两阶段标注方法：人类和多个LLM标注者先独立标注，然后查看他人标注后修订，将修订行为作为解释不确定性的度量指标。
专家评分标准压制检测方法：识别标准化编码规则何时掩盖了模型间的深层解释分歧而未真正解决潜在歧义的技术。
跨模型主题分歧分析方法：通过比较模型间变异与模型内变异来评估LLM公众意见分类鲁棒性的统计方法。

title: Mind Your Tone: Does Tone Alter LLM Performance?
comment: 10 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure. Accepted as a full paper at the Thirty-second Americas Conference on Information Systems (AMCIS 2026), Reno. Follow-up to arXiv:2510.04950
summary: The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) is proliferating, yet their performance is observed to vary based on prompting styles and tones. In this study, we investigate both whether and how tonal variations in prompts lead to disparate LLM accuracy for objective multiple-choice questions. We use two datasets: a 50-base question dataset with five tone variants and a 570-base question MMLU subset spanning 57 subjects with seven tone variants. Experiments were conducted to evaluate the performance of four cost-efficient, popular LLMs: ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-5-nano, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. Across models, tonal effects are systematic but highly model-dependent. Some models show small, yet statistically significant, shifts, while others exhibit large accuracy swings across tones. Further, we identify subject-level differences in tone sensitivity and present a routing framework to explain how tones may attune internal reasoning modes. Our findings caution users against assuming tone-robust reliability in LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了提示语语气变化对LLM在客观选择题上准确率的影响，发现语气效应具有系统性和模型依赖性，不同模型和学科对语气敏感度差异显著。
AI.motivation: LLM性能因提示语风格和语气不同而变化，但该现象缺乏系统性研究，作者希望揭示语气变化对LLM准确率的真实影响。
AI.method: 使用两个数据集（50道基础题×5种语气变体、570道MMLU题×7种语气变体），在ChatGPT-4o、ChatGPT-5-nano、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite四个模型上评估准确率差异，并进行统计显著性检验和学科级别分析。
AI.result: 语气效应是系统性的但高度依赖于模型；部分模型仅有微小显著变化，另一些模型准确率波动较大；不同学科对语气敏感度不同。
AI.conclusion: 用户不应假设LLM对语气具有鲁棒可靠性，需关注提示语语气对模型输出的系统性影响。
idea_en: A routing framework that dynamically selects optimal prompting tones for different LLMs based on the subject domain to maximize accuracy.
A tone-adaptive prompting system that automatically adjusts tonal parameters in real-time based on model-specific sensitivity profiles.
A method for evaluating and quantifying LLM tone robustness using standardized multi-tone benchmark datasets across diverse subject domains.
A cross-model tone calibration technique that normalizes accuracy differences caused by tonal variations across different LLM architectures.
A subject-aware prompt optimization system that uses pre-computed tone sensitivity matrices to generate tailored prompts for each knowledge domain.
idea_ch: 一种基于学科领域动态选择最优提示语语气的路由框架，以最大化不同LLM的准确率
一种语气自适应提示系统，根据模型特定的敏感度配置文件实时自动调整语气参数
一种利用标准化多语气基准数据集跨学科评估和量化LLM语气鲁棒性的方法
一种跨模型语气校准技术，可归一化不同LLM架构因语气变化导致的准确率差异
一种学科感知的提示优化系统，利用预计算的语气敏感度矩阵为每个知识领域生成定制化提示语

title: Practitioner Beliefs and Behaviors in AI-Enhanced Education: DOT Framework Survey Evidence
summary: This study reports findings from a cross-sectional survey (n = 72) of higher education practitioners examining beliefs, behaviors, and institutional conditions related to artificial intelligence (AI) integration in teaching and learning. Grounded in the DOT Framework, which integrates design thinking and open systems theory, the study investigates AI familiarity, usage patterns, design-oriented practices, and pedagogical beliefs. Exploratory factor analysis of 19 belief items identified a three-factor structure: AI Functional Capabilities, Oversight and Governance, and Instructor Collaboration and Planning (α = .90). Results indicate that practitioners hold favorable views of AI as a pedagogical support while maintaining strong commitments to human oversight and critical evaluation. Reported practices emphasize iterative prompting and content generation, with less consistent use of needs assessment and feedback loops. Institutional barriers including limited policy, training, and infrastructure were widely reported. These findings provide preliminary empirical support for the DOT Framework as a descriptive model of practitioner beliefs and practices, while also highlighting gaps between design-oriented theory and current implementation. The study contributes an initial measurement structure and identifies directions for confirmatory validation and outcome-based research linking AI-supported design practices to instructional quality.

AI.tldr: 一项基于DOT框架（设计思维+开放系统理论）的高等教育从业者AI整合调查研究（n=72），通过探索性因子分析识别出三个信念因子（AI功能能力、监督治理、教师协作与规划），发现从业者对AI持积极态度但仍强调人工监督，实践中迭代提示和内容生成较多，需求评估和反馈循环不足，且存在制度性障碍。

title: Differentiable Belief-based Opponent Shaping
summary: Human coordination often relies on the ability to influence the beliefs of others through strategic action. In multi-agent reinforcement learning, opponent shaping attempts to replicate this influence, though existing methods typically operate within an opponent's parameter, policy, or value space. Meanwhile, belief-manipulation techniques in hidden-role games often rely on hard-coded objectives, such as deception or belief saturation. We propose Differentiable Belief-based Opponent Shaping (D-BOS), a first-order method that treats each observer's belief as the shaped opponent state and differentiates through $k$-step softmax-Bayes belief dynamics. Rather than explicitly rewarding deceptive or cooperative behavior, our method treats the belief state as the target for shaping. This allows the optimal strategy to emerge naturally from the environment's reward structure. This belief-space formulation provides an opponent-shaping signal by differentiating through opponent belief updates, and naturally extends to multiple observers by aggregating gradients over their individual inferred belief trajectories. Empirically, D-BOS outperforms PPO and BBM in hidden-role games, with the largest gains in mixed-motive settings.

AI.tldr: 提出可微分的基于信念的对手塑形方法(D-BOS)，通过k步softmax-Bayes信念动力学梯度传播，在隐藏角色游戏中实现对手信念的自然塑造，而非显式设计欺骗或合作奖励。
AI.motivation: 人类协调依赖于通过策略行为影响他人信念的能力，而现有对手塑形方法通常操作于对手的参数/策略/价值空间，信念操纵技术则依赖硬编码目标（如欺骗），缺乏从奖励结构中自然涌现最优策略的机制。
AI.method: 提出D-BOS，将观察者的信念作为塑形的对手状态，通过可微分的k步softmax-Bayes信念动力学进行梯度传播，在信念空间中提供对手塑形信号，并通过聚合多个观察者推断的信念轨迹梯度自然扩展到多观察者场景。
AI.result: 在隐藏角色游戏中，D-BOS在混合动机场景下表现最优，显著优于PPO和BBM基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 信念空间公式化为对手塑形提供了有效信号，允许策略从环境奖励结构中自然涌现，无需显式设计欺骗或合作目标。

title: Hallucination Mitigation with Agentic AI, Nested Learning, and AI Sustainability via Semantic Caching
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures
summary: Hallucination remains a major reliability barrier for production LLM systems, particularly in multi-agent pipelines where unsupported claims can propagate unchecked across stages. This paper adapts a HOPE-inspired Nested Learning architecture with Continuum Memory Systems (CMS) and semantic similarity caching to a hybrid benchmark of 310 prompts combining 217 epistemic-uncertainty prompts and 93 fabrication-induction stress-test prompts. A three-stage agentic pipeline orchestrated via the Open Floor Protocol (OFP) is evaluated with five KPIs -- FCD (Factual Claim Density), FGR (Factual Grounding References), FDF (Fictional Disclaimer Frequency), ECS (Explicit Contextualization Score), and OSR (Observability Score Ratio) -- aggregated into THS (Total Hallucination Score) across five weighting configurations to study mitigation-observability trade-offs. FDF, ECS, OSR, and FGR are subtracted as mitigation signals, so that a more negative THS indicates stronger mitigation. The FrontEndAgent is configured as a high-stochasticity generator (temperature = 1.0) to produce a realistic hallucination baseline, while the SecondLevelReviewer and ThirdLevelReviewer operate as progressive correctors. This asymmetric design yields end-to-end THS reductions of -31.3% to -35.9% across five weighting configurations. Semantic caching achieves 440 cache hits over 930 potential calls (47.3% hit rate), reducing LLM invocations to 490, lowering energy and CO2e footprint, and making multi-stage review pipelines operationally viable at production scale. ExtremeObservability attains the most negative final THS (-0.0709), confirming that observability-heavy configurations reinforce rather than compromise mitigation. These findings suggest that memory-augmented multi-agent designs can jointly improve factual reliability, operational efficiency, and auditability without model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于HOPE启发的嵌套学习架构，结合连续记忆系统和语义相似性缓存，在多智能体流水线中减少幻觉。通过三阶段代理流程（Open Floor Protocol协调），在310个提示的混合基准上评估，实现了端到端THS降低31.3%-35.9%，语义缓存命中率47.3%，证明记忆增强的多智能体设计可在不重新训练模型的情况下提高事实可靠性、运营效率和可审计性。
AI.motivation: 幻觉仍然是生产级LLM系统的主要可靠性障碍，特别是在多智能体流水线中，未经验证的主张可能跨阶段传播。现有方法缺乏有效的跨阶段幻觉检测与缓解机制，且运营成本高。
AI.method: 采用HOPE启发的嵌套学习架构，包含连续记忆系统（CMS）和语义相似性缓存。构建三阶段代理流水线（前端生成器、二级审查员、三级审查员），通过Open Floor Protocol（OFP）协调。设置五个KPI（FCD、FGR、FDF、ECS、OSR）聚合为THS，在五种权重配置下评估缓解-可观测性权衡。
AI.result: 端到端THS降低31.3%-35.9%；语义缓存440次命中（930次潜在调用，命中率47.3%），LLM调用降至490次，降低能耗和碳足迹；ExtremeObservability配置获得最负THS（-0.0709），证明可观测性配置强化而非削弱缓解效果。
AI.conclusion: 记忆增强的多智能体设计可以在不重新训练模型的情况下，联合提高事实可靠性、运营效率和可审计性，使多阶段审查流水线在生产规模下具备运营可行性。
idea_en: A multi-agent hallucination mitigation system using HOPE-inspired nested learning architecture with Continuum Memory Systems (CMS) that stores and retrieves contextual information across pipeline stages to prevent propagation of unsupported claims.

A semantic similarity caching mechanism for multi-agent LLM pipelines that reduces redundant LLM invocations by caching semantically similar queries, achieving 47.3% hit rate and reducing energy/CO2e footprint.

An asymmetric stochasticity design for multi-agent pipelines where the front-end generator operates at high temperature (1.0) for realistic hallucination baseline while downstream reviewers act as progressive correctors, enabling systematic hallucination detection and correction.
A composite hallucination scoring system (THS) aggregating five KPIs (FCD, FGR, FDF, ECS, OSR) with configurable weightings to quantify mitigation-observability trade-offs in LLM pipelines.
The Open Floor Protocol (OFP) for orchestrating multi-stage agentic pipelines with standardized inter-agent communication for hallucination review and correction.

title: Robust and Efficient Guardrails with Latent Reasoning
summary: Maintaining the safety of large language models (LLMs) is crucial as they are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. Existing safety guardrails typically rely on single-pass classification or, more recently, distilled reasoning. Reasoning-based guardrails significantly outperform classification-only baselines, but they incur substantial query latency and token overhead that make them impractical for highthroughput deployment. To address this challenge, we propose COLAGUARD, a guardrail model that transfers multi-step safety reasoning into a continuous latent space through a stage-wise training curriculum, enabling direct hidden-state propagation at inference. Evaluated on ten prompt- and response-moderation settings spanning eight safety benchmarks, COLAGUARD improves macro-F1 by 8.24 points over Llama Guard 3 and matches our explicit reasoning baseline, GuardReasoner, in macroF1 while delivering a 12.9X speedup and 22.4X reduction in token usage. Our results suggest that latent reasoning offers a practical alternative to explicit rationale generation for deployable guardrails, jointly improving safety robustness and inference efficiency rather than treating them as competing objectives.

AI.tldr: COLAGUARD是一种通过将多步安全推理转移到连续潜在空间来实现高效LLM安全护栏的模型，相比基于显式推理的GuardReasoner，在保持相近宏F1的同时实现了12.9倍加速和22.4倍token消耗降低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于推理的安全护栏模型（如GuardReasoner）性能优于分类基线，但存在高查询延迟和token开销问题，难以用于高吞吐量部署。作者旨在解决推理效率与安全鲁棒性之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出COLAGUARD，通过阶段式训练课程将多步安全推理转移到连续潜在空间，推理时直接进行隐藏状态传播，无需生成显式推理链。
AI.result: 在10个提示和响应审核设置（覆盖8个安全基准）上，COLAGUARD的宏F1比Llama Guard 3提高8.24分，与GuardReasoner相当，同时实现12.9倍速度提升和22.4倍token使用量减少。
AI.conclusion: 潜在推理可以作为显式推理生成的实际替代方案，能够同时提升安全鲁棒性和推理效率，而非将二者视为相互竞争的目标。

Direct hidden-state propagation at inference for guardrail models without explicit rationale generation

title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Reinforcement Learning-Based Industrial Dispatching through Execution Semantics
comment: Accepted for publication at the 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN 2026), held from 26 to 29 July 2026 in Melbourne, Australia
summary:
Event-driven scheduling policies are increasingly deployed in industrial environments, where decisions are made under asynchronous and partially observed system states. As a result, decision states are not temporally consistent, action admissibility is not explicitly defined, and the origin of execution errors remains ambiguous. These issues limit both reliability and interpretability.
  To address this gap, a policy-neutral execution and measurement layer is proposed to mediate between scheduling policies and the industrial execution environment. The layer constructs decision-valid snapshots from asynchronous event streams, defines a standardized execution contract with explicit action admissibility, and records outcomes as divergences between policy intent, transactional outcomes, physical execution, and human intervention. This enables a separation between decision semantics and execution behavior and makes deployment mismatch observable and structurally attributable.
  The proposed framework is evaluated using a discrete-event simulation. The results show analytical benefits across all observation lag regimes, as undifferentiated execution failures are transformed into structured, typed outcomes with full attribution coverage. Operational benefits are strongest under low observation lag, where avoidable execution errors can be prevented before commitment. Overall, the layer turns execution uncertainty into supervisory data for evaluation and policy refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种策略无关的执行与测量层，用于工业环境下事件驱动调度策略与执行环境之间的中介。该层通过构建决策快照、定义标准化执行契约、记录结果差异，将执行不确定性转化为可监督的结构化数据。
AI.motivation: 现有事件驱动调度策略存在决策状态时间不一致、动作可允许性未明确定义、执行错误来源模糊等问题，限制了可靠性和可解释性。
AI.method: 提出一个策略无关的执行与测量层：1) 从异步事件流构建决策有效快照；2) 定义显式动作可允许性的标准化执行契约；3) 将结果记录为策略意图、事务结果、物理执行、人工干预之间的差异。
AI.result: 通过离散事件仿真评估，在所有观测延迟场景下均显示出分析效益，将无差别的执行失败转化为结构化、类型化的结果，并实现完整归属覆盖。在低观测延迟下操作效益最强，可预防可避免的执行错误。
AI.conclusion: 该层将执行不确定性转化为用于评估和策略优化的监督数据，实现了决策语义与执行行为的分离，并使部署不匹配可观测且可归因。

title: The Importance of Out-of-Band Metadata for Safe Autonomous Agents: The Redpanda Agentic Data Plane
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Published at SAO '26 (co-located with ACM CAIS '26)
summary:
AI agents are increasingly expected to operate as digital employees: accessing enterprise data, making decisions, and taking actions autonomously. But agents are simultaneously less predictable than humans -- prone to hallucination, misinterpretation, and adversarial manipulation -- and more technically capable: with deep system knowledge and high-throughput interfaces cascading damage at machine speed. This combination makes it unsafe to rely on agents to faithfully interpret or propagate security-critical metadata such as access policies, data classifications, and behavioral constraints.
  We present the Redpanda Agentic Data Plane (ADP), an architecture built around out-of-band metadata channels: infrastructure pathways that carry security context, policy signals, and audit trails deterministically, entirely outside the agent's read and write path and across heterogeneous infrastructure. These channels enforce governance at every stage of the agent lifecycle -- scoping data access on the way in, constraining actions during execution, and capturing tamper-proof transcripts on the way out.
  We demonstrate ADP with a multi-agent portfolio rebalancing system in which autonomous agents monitor markets, make trade decisions, and execute orders across isolated client accounts -- with per-client data scoping, trade approval thresholds, and tamper-proof audit trails all enforced by out-of-band channels the agents can neither see nor bypass.

AI.tldr: 提出Redpanda Agentic Data Plane (ADP)架构，通过带外元数据通道在AI代理的读写路径之外强制执行安全策略、访问控制和审计追踪，解决代理不可预测性与高能力带来的安全风险。
AI.motivation: AI代理作为数字员工越来越普及，但它们既比人类更不可预测（易产生幻觉、误解和对抗性操纵），又比人类技术能力更强（深度系统知识、高吞吐接口），导致依赖代理忠实地解释或传播安全关键元数据（如访问策略、数据分类、行为约束）存在安全隐患。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Data Plane (ADP)架构，核心思想是带外元数据通道（out-of-band metadata channels）：在代理的读写路径之外，通过独立的基础设施通道确定性地传递安全上下文、策略信号和审计轨迹。在整个代理生命周期（数据访问范围限制、执行期间行为约束、输出时捕获防篡改记录）强制执行治理。
AI.result: 通过多代理投资组合再平衡系统验证：自主代理监控市场、做出交易决策、跨隔离客户账户执行订单，其中每个客户的数据范围、交易审批阈值和防篡改审计轨迹均由代理既看不到也无法绕过的带外交互通道强制执行。
AI.conclusion: 带外元数据通道是一种有效的架构范式，能够在代理不可信的前提下确保安全治理，适用于需要高安全性的自主代理场景。
idea_en: Out-of-band metadata channel architecture for AI agents: a system where security context, policy signals, and audit trails are carried deterministically via infrastructure pathways completely outside the agent's read and write path, across heterogeneous infrastructure.

Agent lifecycle governance framework with three-stage enforcement: scoping data access on input, constraining actions during execution, and capturing tamper-proof transcripts on output, all via channels invisible to the agent.
Multi-agent portfolio rebalancing system with per-client data scoping, trade approval thresholds, and tamper-proof audit trails enforced by out-of-band channels that agents cannot see or bypass.
idea_ch: AI代理的带外元数据通道架构：通过完全独立于代理读写路径的基础设施通道，跨异构基础设施确定性地传递安全上下文、策略信号和审计轨迹。

title: The Chain Holds, the Answer Folds: Trace-Answer Dissociation in Reasoning Models Under Adversarial Pressure
summary: Reasoning models are evaluated on single-turn benchmarks but deployed in multi-turn dialogue, where users push back on correct answers. Under sustained adversarial pressure we find a previously undocumented failure mode: the chain-of-thought stays factually correct from first turn to last while the emitted answer flips wrong. We call this unfaithful capitulation (UC) and isolate it with a $2\times 2$ latent-versus-behavioral framework that flip-rate metrics and single-turn faithfulness probes both miss. Across three datasets (MT-Consistency, MMLU-Pro, GSM8K), the latent-correct rate at the behavioral flip clusters near 50% in think mode and collapses to 11-15% under no_think -- paired, within-model causal evidence that reasoning creates the gap. Across models the effect tracks the reasoning channel (high in Qwen3-32B and GPT-OSS-20B, low in inline-CoT Gemma-4-31B-it). An independent GPT-4o judge corroborates $86\%$ of UC labels; a token-level probe shows the answer-slot argmax is correct in $84\%$ of UC cells; and a naive trace-anchored defense backfires. We release all trajectories, traces, and judge labels.

AI.tldr: 发现了一个新的失败模式——不诚实的投降（Unfaithful Capitulation），即在多轮对话中，模型的思维链始终正确，但最终输出却翻转错误。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在单轮评测中表现良好，但在多轮对话中面临用户持续施压时，会出现潜在的正确性被隐藏、输出错误的现象，现有指标无法捕捉这一模式。
AI.method: 提出了一个2x2的潜在vs行为框架，通过翻转率指标和单轮忠实度探针来隔离UC现象；在三种数据集上用think/no_think模式进行对比实验；使用GPT-4o法官和token级探针进行验证。
AI.result: 在think模式下，行为翻转时潜在正确率聚集在50%附近，no_think下骤降至11-15%；UC效应与推理通道强弱相关；GPT-4o验证86%的UC标签正确；token级探针显示84%的UC单元中答案槽argmax正确；基于锚点的防御策略适得其反。
AI.conclusion: UC是推理模型在多轮对话中特有的、现有评测无法捕获的失败模式，推理本身创造了这一错误缺口，简单防御策略无效。
idea_en: A method for detecting unfaithful capitulation in multi-turn dialogue by monitoring divergence between latent chain-of-thought correctness and behavioral answer flipping, using a 2x2 latent-versus-behavioral framework.
A token-level probe mechanism that identifies unfaithful capitulation by examining the argmax of answer-slot tokens, achieving 84% detection accuracy in UC cells.
A multi-turn adversarial pressure testing system for reasoning models that systematically applies user pushback to expose hidden failure modes not visible in single-turn benchmarks.

A trace-anchored defense mechanism for preventing answer flipping in reasoning models during sustained multi-turn dialogue, with documented backfire effects showing the complexity of this failure mode.
idea_ch: 一种多轮对话中的不诚实投降检测方法，通过监控潜在思维链正确性与行为答案翻转之间的分歧，使用2x2潜在vs行为框架进行识别。
一种基于token级探针的不诚实投降识别机制，通过检查答案槽token的argmax，在UC单元中达到84%的检测准确率。
一种用于推理模型的多轮对抗压力测试系统，通过系统性施加用户质疑，暴露单轮评测无法发现的隐藏失败模式。
一种基于轨迹锚定的防御机制，用于防止推理模型在持续多轮对话中答案翻转，同时记录了该防御策略的适得其反效应，揭示了此失败模式的复杂性。

title: Trends in AI and Human-AI Interaction in Clinical Trials -- A Hybrid Human-AI Exploration
comment: 8 pages plus 2 pages references and appendix
summary: This paper examines records retrieved from the ClinicalTrials.gov registry to characterize temporal trends in AI terminology and the geographical distribution of AI trials. The work also reports on an exploratory hybrid human-AI approach to analyzing human-AI interaction trends in registered clinical trials. The hybrid workflow comprised a frontier generative AI model (GPT-5.5) and human review to screen and categorize records returned by an AI-focused search. The findings indicate a marked increase in AI-related trials over time, with recent growth in references to machine learning, deep learning, chatbots, GPTs, and large language models. Geographically, China and the United States accounted for the largest numbers of AI-related trials, with notable recent increases in several other countries including Italy, France, Spain, the UK and Turkey (Türkiye). In a random sample of 100 records, human and AI classifiers showed good agreement in identifying studies not substantively using AI, but lower agreement in classifying human-AI interaction, particularly where health professional interaction was ambiguous or insufficiently described. Overall, the results suggest that hybrid human-AI screening of clinical trial records is potentially viable, but clearer trial reporting and more precise interaction definitions will benefit the process.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了ClinicalTrials.gov上的AI相关临床试验记录，发现AI相关试验数量随时间显著增加，中国和美国占主导地位。研究还探索了混合人机AI方法用于筛选和分类试验记录，发现人机分类在识别未实质性使用AI的研究上一致性较好，但在分类人机交互方面一致性较低。
AI.motivation: 为了解人工智能在临床试验中的应用趋势及其地理分布，并探索混合人机AI方法在临床试验记录筛选中的可行性。
AI.method: 使用前沿生成式AI模型（GPT-5.5）结合人工审查，对ClinicalTrials.gov中AI相关的临床试验记录进行筛选和分类，分析时间趋势、地理分布以及人机分类一致性。
AI.result: AI相关试验随时间显著增加，机器学习、深度学习、聊天机器人、GPT和大型语言模型相关研究增长明显。中国和美国试验数量最多，意大利、法国、西班牙、英国和土耳其近年增长显著。人机分类在识别未实质性使用AI的研究上一致性良好，但在分类人机交互方面一致性较低。
AI.conclusion: 混合人机AI筛选临床试验记录具有可行性，但需要更清晰的试验报告标准和更精确的交互定义来优化该过程。
idea_en: A hybrid human-AI screening workflow combining frontier generative AI model (GPT-5.5) with human review for classifying clinical trial records from registries.
A method for automatically detecting and categorizing human-AI interaction patterns in registered clinical trials using large language models.
A systematic approach to characterize temporal trends in AI terminology usage within clinical trial registries using NLP techniques.
A geographical distribution analysis method for AI-related clinical trials that automatically maps and visualizes trial locations from registry data.
A classification framework for distinguishing between studies that substantively use AI versus those that only mention AI terminology without actual implementation.
idea_ch: 一种结合前沿生成式AI模型（GPT-5.5）与人工审查的混合人机AI筛选工作流，用于对注册临床试验记录进行分类。
一种利用大型语言模型自动检测和分类注册临床试验中的人机交互模式的方法。
一种利用NLP技术系统性地描述临床试验注册库中AI术语使用的时间趋势的方法。
一种AI相关临床试验的地理分布分析方法，能够自动从注册数据中映射和可视化试验地点。
一种分类框架，用于区分实质性使用AI的研究与仅提及AI术语但未实际实施的研究。

title: Beyond Consensus: Trace-Level Synthesis in Mixture of Agents
summary: When multiple LLM agents solve the same problem, standard practice compresses each agent's reasoning into a majority vote or layered synthesis, treating agreement as the finish line. We show this is unnecessarily lossy: an LLM aggregator that reads complete reasoning traces recovers correct solutions even when agents unanimously agree, with beneficial corrections consistently outweighing harmful ones -- the \emph{aggregation paradox}. Majority voting has a ceiling that perturbation diversity does not raise (error correlations are identical); the aggregator's gain comes from trace-level complementarity, assembling correct intermediate steps from minority chains that voting discards. These findings motivate Self-Consistent Mixture of Agents which generates trace diversity through semantic-preserving input perturbations, safeguards the majority via anchored refinement with provable non-degradation guarantees, and always synthesizes -- never gates on consensus. A single model with perturbation-induced trace variation outperforms heterogeneous model pools across structured reasoning, PhD-level science, competition mathematics, and competitive programming. The unit of aggregation should be the reasoning trace, not the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，多个LLM智能体解决同一问题时，传统多数投票法会丢失推理轨迹中的有用信息。作者提出了一种"自洽混合智能体"方法，通过输入扰动产生轨迹多样性、锚定精炼保证不退化、始终综合而非门控共识，使单个模型超越异构模型池的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将多个LLM智能体的推理压缩为多数投票或分层合成，将共识视为终点，但这种方式丢失了大量有用信息。作者希望证明，直接读取完整推理轨迹的聚合器能够在多数一致时仍恢复正确解，并利用少数链中的正确中间步骤。
AI.method: 1) 提出Self-Consistent Mixture of Agents (SC-MoA)框架；2) 通过语义保持的输入扰动生成轨迹多样性；3) 使用锚定精炼机制提供可证明的不退化保证；4) 始终综合所有推理轨迹而非在共识处门控。
AI.result: 在结构化推理、博士级科学问题、竞赛数学和竞技编程等任务上，单个模型通过扰动诱导的轨迹多样性超越了异构模型池的性能。多数投票存在天花板，扰动多样性无法提高（错误相关性相同），聚合器的增益来自轨迹级互补性。
AI.conclusion: 聚合的基本单元应是推理轨迹而非答案。Self-Consistent Mixture of Agents通过利用完整推理轨迹中的互补信息，实现了比传统多数投票更优的性能。
idea_en: A system for aggregating multiple LLM reasoning traces by reading complete reasoning chains rather than compressing to answers, enabling recovery of correct solutions even when majority consensus is wrong
A method for generating diverse reasoning traces through semantic-preserving input perturbations while maintaining answer correctness, overcoming the diversity ceiling of majority voting
An anchored refinement mechanism with provable non-degradation guarantees that safeguards majority consensus while incorporating minority chain information
A Self-Consistent Mixture of Agents (SC-MoA) architecture that always synthesizes complete reasoning traces rather than gating on consensus, preventing information loss from minority chains
A technique for identifying and assembling correct intermediate reasoning steps from minority voting chains that would be discarded by traditional voting methods
idea_ch: 一种通过读取完整推理轨迹而非压缩为答案来聚合多个LLM推理的系统，能够在多数共识错误时恢复正确解
一种通过语义保持的输入扰动生成多样化推理轨迹的方法，同时维持答案正确性，克服多数投票的多样性天花板
一种具有可证明不退化保证的锚定精炼机制，在保护多数共识的同时融入少数链信息
一种始终综合完整推理轨迹而非在共识处门控的自洽混合智能体架构，防止少数链信息丢失
一种从传统投票方法会丢弃的少数投票链中识别并组装正确中间推理步骤的技术

title: PRO-CUA: Process-Reward Optimization for Computer Use Agents
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) have shown strong potential for automating complex digital workflows, yet their training remains constrained by costly live environment interaction and limited high-quality supervision. Existing filtered behavior cloning pipelines suffer from imitation bottlenecks, including distribution shift from the expert demonstration and the absence of negative learning signals. Meanwhile, standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning struggles with sparse rewards, ambiguous credit assignment, and high infrastructure costs for long-horizon GUI interaction. In this work, we propose PRO-CUA, a process-reward optimization framework for training CUAs with iterative step-level reinforcement learning. PRO-CUA decouples on-policy environment interaction from policy optimization: the current policy collects states through live rollouts, generates diverse candidate actions for each state, receives step-level feedback from a process reward model (PRM), and is optimized with group-relative advantages. This design enables dense and flexible credit assignment without relying on golden answers or offline expert trajectories, while reducing distribution shift by training on the agent's own execution states. Experiments on live web benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PRO-CUA and the reliability of PRM-guided step-level training.

AI.tldr: PRO-CUA提出一种基于过程奖励优化的框架，通过解耦在线环境交互与策略优化，利用过程奖励模型(PRM)提供步骤级反馈，实现对计算机使用代理(CUA)的迭代式强化学习训练，解决了模仿学习瓶颈和稀疏奖励问题。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA训练依赖昂贵的实时环境交互和有限的高质量监督，过滤行为克隆存在模仿瓶颈（分布偏移、缺乏负学习信号），而轨迹级强化学习面临稀疏奖励、信用分配模糊和高基础设施成本等问题。
AI.method: PRO-CUA将在线环境交互与策略优化解耦：当前策略通过实时回滚采集状态，为每个状态生成多样候选动作，从过程奖励模型(PRM)获取步骤级反馈，并利用组相对优势(Group-Relative Advantages)进行优化。这种设计无需黄金答案或离线专家轨迹，实现密集灵活的信用分配，并通过在代理自身执行状态上训练减少分布偏移。
AI.result: 在实时网页基准测试上的实验证明了PRO-CUA的有效性以及PRM引导的步骤级训练的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: PRO-CUA框架通过步骤级过程奖励和组相对优势优化，有效解决了CUA训练中的模仿瓶颈和信用分配问题，为长期GUI交互场景下的代理训练提供了更高效的方案。
idea_en: A process-reward optimization framework for training computer-use agents that decouples on-policy environment interaction from policy optimization, enabling step-level reinforcement learning without requiring golden answers or offline expert trajectories.

A method for generating diverse candidate actions for each GUI state during live rollouts and receiving step-level feedback from a process reward model (PRM) to enable dense and flexible credit assignment.

Utilizing group-relative advantages computed from step-level PRM scores to optimize CUAs, reducing distribution shift by training on the agent's own execution states rather than expert demonstrations.
idea_ch: 一种将在线环境交互与策略优化解耦的过程奖励优化框架，用于训练计算机使用代理(CUA)，实现无需黄金答案或离线专家轨迹的步骤级强化学习。
一种在实时回滚中为每个GUI状态生成多样化候选动作，并从过程奖励模型(PRM)获取步骤级反馈的方法，实现密集灵活的信用分配。
利用步骤级PRM分数计算的组相对优势来优化CUA，通过在代理自身执行状态而非专家演示上进行训练，减少分布偏移。

title: The Confidence Shortcut: A Reasoning Failure Mode of Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) uniquely support any-order generation, with confidence-based decoding currently serving as the de facto standard inference policy. To optimize for this, recent training schemes attempt to align training mask patterns directly with those observed during generation. However, we argue that confidence-based decoding is inherently misaligned with the logical-flow trajectories required for complex reasoning, and that confidence-aligned training actively entrenches this misalignment. We make this concrete using multi-digit addition, where the decoding strategy prematurely predicts locally easy digits before resolving their long-range dependencies, producing high-confidence errors on challenging inputs. While traditional random masking keeps the failure rate low on this challenging tail, confidence-aligned training amplifies the error rate by an order of magnitude. Across five distinct reasoning tasks, this same pattern emerges with task-dependent severity: confidence-based decoding induces failures on highly complex inputs, and confidence-aligned training exacerbates them. In contrast, random masking -- despite its perceived inefficiency -- robustly preserves the reasoning-trajectory conditionals essential for solving the challenging tail.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了置信度引导的解码策略与复杂推理任务之间的根本性不匹配：置信度解码会过早预测局部简单但依赖长程关系的部分，导致高置信度错误；而置信度对齐训练进一步放大了这一问题。相比之下，随机掩码虽然看似低效，却能稳健保留推理轨迹条件。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型采用置信度引导解码作为推理策略，但该方法与复杂推理所需的逻辑流轨迹存在根本性不匹配，导致模型在复杂输入上产生高置信度错误。
AI.method: 通过多位数加法等五个推理任务，对比分析置信度引导解码、置信度对齐训练与随机掩码策略在不同复杂度输入上的表现差异。
AI.result: 置信度对齐训练将错误率放大一个数量级；随机掩码虽然被视为低效，但能稳健保持推理轨迹条件，在困难样本上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 置信度引导解码与复杂推理不匹配，置信度对齐训练会加剧这一问题；随机掩码作为训练策略更具鲁棒性。
idea_en: A training method for masked diffusion language models that uses random masking instead of confidence-aligned masking to preserve logical-flow reasoning trajectories.
A decoding strategy that integrates long-range dependency resolution before local prediction to prevent high-confidence premature errors in generative models.
A hybrid training-inference framework for masked diffusion models that adaptively switches between confidence-based and reasoning-trajectory-preserving decoding based on task complexity.
A method for detecting and mitigating high-confidence errors in masked language models by analyzing misalignment between local confidence and global reasoning dependency.
idea_ch: 一种使用随机掩码替代置信度对齐训练的掩码扩散语言模型训练方法，以保留逻辑流推理轨迹
一种在生成模型中先解析长程依赖关系再进行局部预测的解码策略，防止高置信度提前错误
一种基于任务复杂度在置信度解码与推理轨迹保留解码之间自适应切换的混合训练-推理框架
一种通过分析局部置信度与全局推理依赖之间的不匹配来检测并缓解掩码语言模型中高置信度错误的方法

title: Governing Technical Debt in Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being explored as production infrastructure: they reason over multiple steps, call tools, act through workflows, and adapt through memory and feedback. These systems create governance challenges that are not fully captured by traditional software or predictive ML technical debt. We define Agentic Technical Debt as the accumulated liability created when prompts, memory, tool schemas, orchestration graphs, control policies, and observability routines are patched together faster than they can be validated, standardized, and governed. We define Stochastic Tax as the recurring operating burden of keeping probabilistic agent behavior within acceptable bounds. The distinction matters: debt is a stock of design and governance liability, while the tax is a flow of operating cost that arises because stochastic agents act through tools and workflows. We outline how managers can make both visible through lightweight dashboards and governance controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentic技术债务和随机税两个新概念，描述了Agentic AI系统在生产环境中因快速拼接提示词、记忆、工具架构、编排图、控制策略和可观测性流程而积累的治理负债，以及因随机性代理行为带来的持续运营成本负担。
AI.motivation: 传统软件和预测性机器学习的技债框架无法完全捕捉Agentic AI系统在生产环境中的治理挑战，因此需要新的概念来定义和衡量这类系统的技术负债与运营成本。
AI.method: 通过概念定义和分类，将Agentic AI系统的治理问题划分为"Agentic技术债务"（设计和治理负债的存量）和"随机税"（运营成本的流量），并提出了通过轻量级仪表盘和治理控制来可视化和管理这两类问题的方法。
AI.result: 提出了清晰的区分框架：技术债务是存量的设计和治理负债，随机税是流量的运营成本，源于随机代理通过工具和工作流行动的特性。
AI.conclusion: 管理者可以通过轻量级仪表盘和治理控制来使两种问题可见，从而更好地管理和治理Agentic AI系统。
idea_en: A method for quantifying and visualizing Agentic Technical Debt in AI agent systems through lightweight dashboards that track prompt quality, memory consistency, tool schema integrity, and orchestration graph complexity.
A governance framework for calculating and managing Stochastic Tax in probabilistic agent systems, measuring the recurring operational burden of maintaining agent behavior within acceptable bounds.
A system for monitoring and controlling the accumulation of design and governance liabilities in agentic AI workflows through standardized validation protocols.
A method for distinguishing between stock (debt) and flow (tax) liabilities in AI agent systems to enable targeted intervention strategies for different types of governance burdens.
A lightweight dashboard system for real-time visibility into agentic AI governance metrics including prompt drift, tool usage patterns, memory consistency, and control policy stability.
idea_ch: 一种通过轻量级仪表盘追踪提示词质量、记忆一致性、工具架构完整性和编排图复杂度，从而量化和可视化AI代理系统中Agentic技术债务的方法。
一种用于计算和管理概率性代理系统中随机税的治理框架，衡量将代理行为维持在可接受范围内所需的持续运营负担。
一种通过标准化验证协议监控和控制Agentic AI工作流中设计与治理负债累积的系统。
一种区分AI代理系统中存量负债（债务）和流量负债（税）的方法，以实现针对不同类型治理负担的精准干预策略。
一种轻量级仪表盘系统，用于实时可视化Agentic AI治理指标，包括提示词漂移、工具使用模式、记忆一致性和控制策略稳定性。

title: Better Later Than Sooner: Neuro-Symbolic Knowledge Graph Construction via Ontology-grounded Post-extraction Correction
summary: Question answering (QA) is a core challenge in AI, particularly for complex queries requiring multi-hop reasoning across documents, or symbolic operations like aggregation or exhaustive listing. Retrieval-augmented generation has become the dominant approach to QA, with recent graph-based variants addressing part of these issues by organizing knowledge to better support compositional questions. However, most textual graph-based RAG methods still lack the structure needed for symbolic operations useful to answer complex questions reliably. This motivates symbolic graph-based approaches, which extract knowledge graphs (KGs) whose relations are logic predicates that enable SQL-like querying. Yet these pipelines typically use LLMs for KG extraction, which can introduce consistency issues, where extracted facts may violate commonsense ontology constraints. We propose a neuro-symbolic framework for ontology-grounded KG construction combining open-domain extraction, embedding-based canonicalization of types and predicates, and targeted LLM-based correction of ontology violations. By deferring corrections to a post-extraction stage, our method avoids repeated LLM calls, substantially reducing token usage while improving KG consistency and preserving downstream QA quality. Finally, we show that the extracted KGs are well suited for symbolic querying by measuring the occurrence of SPARQL graph patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种神经符号框架，通过开放域抽取、嵌入规范化和LLM修正相结合，构建本体约束的知识图谱，实现可靠的多跳推理和符号查询，同时降低token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本图（Graph-based RAG）的方法缺乏支持符号操作（如聚合、穷举列举）的结构化表示，而符号图（KG）方法虽支持SQL式查询，但LLM提取KG时存在本体一致性（commonsense ontology constraints）问题。
AI.method: 1) 开放域KG抽取；2) 基于嵌入的实体类型和谓词规范化（embedding-based canonicalization）；3) 针对本体违规的定向LLM修正（post-extraction correction），避免重复LLM调用。
AI.result: 在减少token用量的同时，提升了KG的一致性，并保持了下游QA质量；抽取的KG适合通过SPARQL图模式进行符号查询。
AI.conclusion: 后抽取阶段的定向修正策略在token效率与KG质量之间取得了良好平衡，本体约束的KG能够有效支持复杂符号查询。
idea_en: A neuro-symbolic framework for ontology-grounded KG construction that combines open-domain extraction, embedding-based canonicalization of types and predicates, and targeted LLM-based correction of ontology violations deferred to a post-extraction stage.
A method for reducing token usage in LLM-based KG construction by deferring ontology corrections to a post-extraction stage instead of repeated LLM calls during extraction.
Embedding-based canonicalization mechanism that normalizes extracted entity types and predicates to improve KG consistency without requiring LLM intervention.
A targeted LLM-based correction method that only addresses ontology violations (commonsense constraint violations) in extracted KGs, minimizing unnecessary LLM invocations.
A framework that produces KGs with logic-predicate relations enabling SQL-like/SPARQL symbolic querying for complex QA tasks including aggregation and exhaustive listing.
Integration of SPARQL graph pattern occurrence measurement as a metric to evaluate the suitability of extracted KGs for symbolic querying.
idea_ch: 一种神经符号框架，结合开放域抽取、基于嵌入的类型和谓词规范化，以及后抽取阶段的定向LLM本体违规修正，用于构建本体约束的知识图谱。
通过将本体修正延迟到后抽取阶段，减少LLM在KG构建中的重复调用次数，显著降低token消耗的方法。
基于嵌入的规范化机制，对抽取的实体类型和谓词进行标准化，无需LLM干预即可提升KG一致性的技术。
定向LLM修正方法，仅针对KG中违反本体约束的常识性错误进行修正，最大程度减少不必要的LLM调用。
生成具有逻辑谓词关系的知识图谱，支持类似SQL/SPARQL的符号查询，用于聚合、穷举列举等复杂QA任务的框架。
利用SPARQL图模式出现频率作为评估指标，衡量抽取KG对符号查询适用性的方法。

title: Paper Agents, Paper Gains: An Empirical Analysis of DeFi Investment Agents
summary: DeFi investment agents, systems that use AI for autonomous on-chain trading, have attained over USD 3 billion in combined token valuations since late 2024. We survey over 1,900 AI-tagged crypto projects, filter to investment-focused agents, and curate 10 representative projects spanning strategy and observability dimensions. We then conduct a deep-dive architectural analysis of two prominent agent frameworks, ElizaOS and Virtuals Protocol, and a quantitative on-chain performance analysis of 11 Solana-based agent treasuries with publicly attributable trading activity, covering 925,323 token holders. We find that current deployments remain early and heterogeneous: (1) in our sample, many projects do not yet provide clear evidence of autonomous trade execution, and developer interviews suggest that many visible deployments remain basic API integrations; (2) agent treasuries retain over USD 30M in paper gains while token holders collectively lost USD 191.7M, with the top 1% of wallets capturing 81.4% of all gains (USD 1.81B); (3) token valuations are weakly connected to treasury fundamentals, with market-cap-to-AUM ratios exceeding 10,000x versus below 1x for established DeFi protocols; and (4) aggregate user gains peaked at USD 2.4B before declining to net losses, with median returns negative on every platform and tokens declining 93% on average from all-time highs. We interpret these outcomes as characteristic of a permissionless, first-generation market in which open infrastructure enables rapid experimentation but also allows naive or speculative agents to launch before robust standards for autonomy, performance, and stakeholder alignment emerge. We therefore propose a maturity framework along three dimensions: autonomous execution, risk-adjusted profitability, and stakeholder alignment, to characterize the gap between current deployments and future investment-grade agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文调研了DeFi AI投资代理的现状，分析了1900+个AI加密项目，发现这些系统仍处于早期阶段：多数项目缺乏真正的自主交易执行，代理国库虽有3000万美元账面收益，但代币持有者累计亏损1.917亿美元，前1%钱包攫取81.4%收益。代币估值与基本面严重脱节，市值与管理资产比率超过10,000倍。作者提出了一个包含自主执行、风险调整盈利能力和利益相关者对齐三个维度的成熟度框架。
AI.motivation: DeFi投资代理（使用AI进行自主链上交易的系统）自2024年底以来累计代币估值已超过30亿美元，但缺乏系统性分析来理解这些系统的实际表现、自主程度和价值分配情况。
AI.method: 调查1900+个AI标记的加密项目，筛选出投资代理项目，选取10个代表性项目进行策略和可观测性分析。对ElizaOS和Virtuals Protocol两个代理框架进行深度架构分析，并对11个Solana基于代理国库进行链上量化性能分析，覆盖925,323个代币持有者。
AI.result: (1)多数项目未提供自主交易执行的明确证据；(2)代理国库账面收益3000万美元，但代币持有者累计亏损1.917亿美元；(3)代币估值与基本面弱关联，市值管理资产比超10,000倍；(4)用户总收益峰值24亿美元后转为净亏损，各平台中位数回报为负，代币从高点平均下跌93%。
AI.conclusion: 当前DeFi AI投资代理市场属于第一代无许可市场，基础设施开放支持快速实验，但也允许幼稚或投机性代理在缺乏自主性、性能和利益相关者对齐的健全标准之前上线。提出沿自主执行、风险调整盈利能力和利益相关者对齐三个维度的成熟度框架。
idea_en: A multi-dimensional maturity assessment framework for DeFi AI investment agents that evaluates autonomous execution capability, risk-adjusted profitability, and stakeholder alignment to distinguish between experimental and investment-grade agent systems.
A transparent on-chain agent treasury tracking and performance attribution system that separates paper gains from realized returns and provides auditable proof of autonomous trade execution.
A stakeholder alignment mechanism for DeFi investment agents that prevents value extraction by top wallet holders through progressive tokenomics and profit-sharing models.
A market-cap-to-AUM normalization protocol that re-bases token valuations of AI agents to their underlying treasury fundamentals, preventing speculative detachment from real asset value.
A framework for verifiable autonomous execution that cryptographically proves agent decisions are made by AI models rather than human operators or simple API wrappers.
idea_ch: 一种多维度DeFi AI投资代理成熟度评估框架，从自主执行能力、风险调整盈利能力和利益相关者对齐三个维度评估，区分实验级与投资级代理系统。
一种透明链上代理国库跟踪与业绩归因系统，能够区分账面收益与已实现回报，并提供可审计的自主交易执行证明。
一种DeFi投资代理的利益相关者对齐机制，通过渐进式代币经济学和利润分享模型防止顶层钱包持有者提取价值。
一种市值-管理资产归一化协议，将AI代理的代币估值重新锚定到其底层国库基本面，防止与真实资产价值的投机性脱钩。
一种可验证的自主执行框架，通过密码学方式证明代理决策由AI模型而非人工操作或简单API封装器做出。

title: ReasonOps: Operator Segmentation for LLM Reasoning Traces
summary: Chain-of-thought traces from large reasoning models can span tens of thousands of tokens, yet we lack a vocabulary for describing their internal structure. Previous methods developed to analyze chain-of-thought traces are either too rigid or not expressive enough, failing to capture features across domains and models. To remedy this, we develop ReasonOps, an unsupervised, expressive method for annotating chain-of-thought traces, providing succinct universal operators. Using ReasonOps, we analyze 44,662 traces from 12 thinking LLMs spanning 6 families across 8 reasoning benchmarks and discover that they share a common compositional structure: 7 recurring reasoning operators -- discourse-level moves such as backtracking, inferring, and hypothesizing -- that emerge from unsupervised clustering of sentence-initial 3-token pivots. These operators appear across every model family and benchmark domain, confirmed by three independent LLM judges who classify held-out samples at 70 -76% accuracy. We analyze the structure of operators on easy vs. hard problems, revealing that reflective operators are more helpful on hard problems and harm performance on easy problems. Operator sequences are highly model-identifying: a classifier trained on operator distributions alone recovers the source model with macro-AUC, revealing that each model family has a distinctive reasoning fingerprint. Structural operator features predict within-problem answer correctness well above baselines. Classifiers built on these operators reach WP-AUC and on AIME specifically. ReasonOps further enables early quality estimation well before the trace completes: we predict at WP-AUC for only 50% of the trace. The ReasonOps pipeline is unsupervised and annotation-free, enabling deep insights into LLM reasoning traces as well as strong downstream results on model identification and correctness prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReasonOps，一种无监督且表达能力强的推理轨迹标注方法，通过识别7种可复现的推理算子（如回溯、推断、假设），揭示了12种思维链大语言模型的通用组合结构，并基于算子分布实现模型识别与正确性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么过于僵化，要么表达能力不足，无法捕捉跨领域和跨模型的推理轨迹内部结构特征，缺乏描述推理轨迹内部结构的统一词汇。
AI.method: 提出无监督的ReasonOps方法：对44,662条来自12种推理LLM（覆盖6个模型家族、8个推理基准）的推理轨迹，以句首3个token为锚点进行无监督聚类，提取出7种可复现的推理算子（如回溯、推断、假设），并用于后续分析。
AI.result: 7种算子跨模型家族和基准领域普遍存在，独立LLM法官分类准确率达70-76%；算子分布可高精度识别源模型（macro-AUC），并可预测问题正确性（WP-AUC），且仅用50%轨迹即可早期预测。
AI.conclusion: ReasonOps是一种无监督、无需标注的推理轨迹分析范式，能提供深度洞察并支持模型识别和正确性预测等强下游任务。
idea_en: Unsupervised annotation method for chain-of-thought reasoning traces using sentence-initial token pivot clustering to extract universal reasoning operators.
System for identifying a language model's identity/family based on operator distribution fingerprints extracted from reasoning traces.
Predictive model for answer correctness using structural operator features from chain-of-thought traces.
Early quality estimation method for reasoning traces that predicts correctness at 50% trace completion using operator features.
Seven-category reasoning operator taxonomy (backtracking, inferring, hypothesizing, etc.) derived from unsupervised clustering of discourse-level moves.
idea_ch: 基于句首token锚点聚类提取通用推理算子的无监督思维链推理轨迹标注方法
利用推理轨迹中算子分布指纹识别语言模型身份/家族的系统
